description: This file defines the class ProjectActivityDetailedReportData which implements report data handling for project activity details within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for normalizing report data and generating metadata, utilizing various traits and external services to gather and format project activity information based on search parameters.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating detailed report data related to project activities, including normalization of data and retrieval of report metadata based on provided search filters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates an array of normalized project activity report data based on the search filters, including employee names and total durations.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata for the report, including total counts, summed hours and minutes, and normalized project activity details.
